title: Ice Tea Tycoon
description: Brew, sell, and build your iced tea empire!
about: Ice Tea Tycoon is a tycoon game about building your own iced tea business in Indonesia. Start small with a simple street stand and work your way up by perfecting your recipe, managing supplies, and making strategic business decisions.
features: Set up shop in different locations and adjust prices to maximize profits
Balance sweetness, ice and tea strength to suit different customers
Upgrade your stand, hire staff and unlock new features
Arcade-style Combo Bar that triggers Customer Rush events
Changing weather, customer moods and market trends
